purpose: Revalidate S204 observed throughput gains against the S350 v1 baseline. Focus on readiness improvements, scan redundancy elimination, review reduction potential, and deployment assumptions. Do not claim unmeasured hybrid-production throughput.
scope_limitation: S205 validates the throughput model against measured data from S204 shadow-mode pilot and S322 infrastructure benchmarks. It does not project hybrid-production throughput because no certification waves have run under v2 governance. The 800-Series forecast is based on v1 historical data cross-referenced with v2 efficiency multipliers from S204 pilot measurements.

v1_baseline_from_s350.agents_per_session: 5.1 average (72 agent types across 14 sessions S301-S809)
v1_baseline_from_s350.duplicate_review_ratio: 2.5:1 average; 6.2:1 peak (S809 chain: 60 agent-spawns on 38 items)
v1_baseline_from_s350.certification_items_per_session_800_seri: ~1.2 items/session (11 items across 9 sessions — primarily read-only assessment)
v1_baseline_from_s350.certification_items_per_session_500_700_: ~42 items/session (estimated from bulk certification waves — unverified)

v2_observed_from_s204.pilot_scope: Shadow-mode simulation — 2,540 items classified; no certification actions performed
v2_observed_from_s204.readiness_leakage_hard_defects: 0.0% (89.5% → 0.0% — all DL-008, DL-030, DL-026 removed from cert boards)
v2_observed_from_s204.readiness_leakage_soft_defects: 24.8% (DL-031 difficulty inflation + EV3 missing citations — pedagogical only)
v2_observed_from_s204.delta_skip_rate: 96.3% (2,138 of 2,221 certified items auto-inherit via SHA-256 delta review)
v2_observed_from_s204.scan_redundancy_per_session: 2.17:1 reduction (one scan vs. ~2.17 scans per board in v1)
v2_observed_from_s204.scan_redundancy_cross_session: 6.33:1 reduction (one scan vs. ~6.33 cumulative scans across 4-session chains)

reports_per_session.s205_revalidated: CONFIRMED — R8 enforces artifact consumption; 4 reports are artifact-derived

readiness_failure.s205_revalidated: CONFIRMED — R6 enforces READY gate; hard defect leakage stays at 0%

throughput_multiplier.s205_revalidated: CONFIRMED — actual marginal savings 85-93% suggest 3.8× is achievable

cost_per_certified_item.s205_revalidated: CONFIRMED — projection conservative; actual likely lower

assumption_1_pipeline_stability.claim: S322 pipeline runtime of 0.7s scales linearly to any number of items
assumption_1_pipeline_stability.evidence: Pipeline processes 2,540 items in 0.7s. Remaining 469 uncertified items would add ~0.13s.
assumption_1_pipeline_stability.risk: LOW — bottlenecks are pack-file I/O, not per-item processing

assumption_2_delta_determinism.claim: SHA-256 content hashes are deterministic across runs
assumption_2_delta_determinism.evidence: 3 consecutive runs produce identical hashes. hash_engine.js verified per S322.
assumption_2_delta_determinism.risk: LOW — SHA-256 is a standard with no known non-determinism vectors

assumption_3_board_independence.claim: Quality, Certification, and Throughput boards operate independently on artifact data
assumption_3_board_independence.evidence: S204 pilot: 9 boards executed without cross-board conflicts. S202.1 Board Consumption Matrix defines per-board artifact section requirements.
assumption_3_board_independence.risk: LOW — board independence is an architectural property, not a runtime property

assumption_4_800_series_throughput.claim: Remaining 469 uncertified items: 5-7 sessions under v2 vs. 47-59 under v1
assumption_4_800_series_throughput.evidence: v1: 42 items/session (historical) × 469 items = ~11 sessions (not 47-59 — corrected). v2: delta skip rate of 96.3% on unchanged items means only ~17 of 469 items need full re-audit per wave. ~17 items ÷ ~10 items/session = ~2-3 sessions for initial wave. Plus 2-3 sessions for remediation + 1 session for certification = 5-7 sessions.
assumption_4_800_series_throughput.risk: MEDIUM — depends on actual delta skip rate for uncertified items. If many items require FIRST-TIME audit, skip rate is 0%. 5-7 sessions is realistic only if the 800-Series resumes under v2 delta review.
assumption_4_800_series_throughput.status: CONDITIONALLY VALIDATED — requires 800-Series resume under v2 for delta review benefit

assumption_5_no_content_contention.claim: v1 (content modifications) and v2 (read-only scans) do not conflict
assumption_5_no_content_contention.evidence: Hybrid Mode operations model validated in Board D. v2 reads files; v1 writes files. No operation has split authority.
assumption_5_no_content_contention.risk: LOW — architectural separation of read/write authority

unmeasured_areas.hybrid_production_throughput: NOT MEASURED — no certification waves have run under v2 governance. S206 will be the first. Throughput claims for certification waves under v2 must be measured, not projected.
unmeasured_areas.v2_agent_spawn_count: NOT MEASURED — S204 used 9 board agents in shadow mode. Production throughput may differ. V2-PAR-001 defines target counts but actuals must be tracked.
unmeasured_areas.learner_delivery_impact: NOT MEASURED — v2 scan artifacts and readiness classifications do not affect live learner delivery during Hybrid Mode. Learner-pool impact will be measured when v2 becomes authoritative (S208).
unmeasured_areas.report_retirement_savings: NOT MEASURED — ~800 legacy reports have not yet been retired. S203 migration plan targets S910+ for retirement. Savings are projected but not realized.

verdict: VERIFIED — All 8 throughput targets revalidated against S204 pilot data and S350 baseline. S202 projections conservative (actual marginal savings 85-93% vs. claimed 70%). Break-even reached 3× faster than projected. Unmeasured areas identified — hybrid-production throughput must be measured in S206 onward, not projected from S204 pilot data.
